title: cq-2 re-plan of #3364 PRs B/C/D: PR B follow-ups + PR C exit-code chain + PR D unchanged
summary: v2 (re-scoped per binding HITL cq-2). cq-2 re-plan. PR B (slice-1) is COMPLETE (tasks 1-1..1-4 landed: commits 4fcf1ed7a, c2a77847a, 3593d497c) and is NOT re-derived; two post-consensus review follow-ups are carried as TASK-1-5 (wire the production slice_closed_emitter at _run_implement.py:86 — currently default-None so slice.closed never fires in prod) and TASK-1-6 (production-chain integration test, not a hand-published event). PR C (slice-2) is RE-PLANNED to the corrected exit-code mechanism per cq-2: only exit codes cross the pod boundary, so the transient rate-limit classification rides a distinct EX_RATE_LIMITED exit code mirroring the EX_AUTH_FATAL chain (#3373) instead of sniffing error text at the streak-exhaustion site, and the per-arm recording now lives in orchestrator/event_loop/ after the #3447 JobSupervisor relocation. Chain (7 impl tasks + 1 test): auth_errors.py (EX_RATE_LIMITED + is_transient_rate_limit_error) -> egg_agent/__main__.py -> kubernetes_spawner/_models.py + event_loop/__init__.py (JOB_OUTCOME_RATE_LIMITED + outcome_for) -> event_loop/_loop.py (_observe_jobs branch) -> event_loop/_supervisor.py (record_rate_limited, paced/NO streak increment => never trips fail-streak halt, AC-C1 core) -> supervision_policy.py (pacing + fingerprint constants) -> concurrent_executor.py (windowed retry / loop guard / threshold OVERSEER_ALERT / landed-slice preservation). PR D (slice-3) UNCHANGED (coverage-map gate -> deletions -> remove overseer_owns_host_detection); tasks 3-1..3-5 carried verbatim. cq-1 stands: no hard ceiling, OVERSEER_ALERT past a threshold. Three independent slices, disjoint file sets (verified no cross-slice overlap), one PR each. Grounded live @ eba3ca55. || cq-2 UPDATE: PR C (slice-2) re-scoped from the original 3 files to the faithful EX_RATE_LIMITED exit-code mirror (== cq-2 opt-1) after the coder found AC-C1 unreachable in 3 files and #3447 moved JobSupervisor into orchestrator/event_loop/_supervisor.py. New PR C spans auth_errors.py + egg_agent/__main__.py + kubernetes_spawner/_models.py + event_loop/__init__.py + event_loop/_loop.py + event_loop/_supervisor.py + supervision_policy.py + concurrent_executor.py; 8 tasks (TASK-2-1..2-8); explicit AC-C6 regression for the new exit-code risk surface. opt-2 (3-file partial AC-C1) was rejected by the human. B and D unchanged.
